The function is `emit()` in `src/lib/event-bus.ts`. I searched every import of `@/lib/event-bus` and checked the call sites. These 13 application files call `emit(...)` directly:

- **Route handler:** `src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts` publishes `webhook.delivery_requested`.
- **Jobs:**
  - `src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts` publishes `issue.overdue`.
  - `src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts` publishes `billing.plan_changed`.
- **Services under `src/server/services/`:**
  - `issue-service.ts` publishes `issue.created`, `issue.updated`, `issue.status_changed`, `issue.assigned` and `issue.archived`.
  - `project-service.ts` publishes `project.created`, `project.archived` and `project.restored`.
  - `comment-service.ts` publishes `comment.created` and `comment.deleted`.
  - `member-service.ts` publishes `member.role_changed` and `member.removed`.
  - `invitation-service.ts` publishes `member.invited` and `member.joined`.
  - `organization-service.ts` publishes `member.joined`.
  - `billing-service.ts` publishes `billing.limit_exceeded` and `billing.plan_changed`.
  - `usage-service.ts` publishes `billing.limit_exceeded`. It also subscribes to events, but it does publish.
  - `feature-flag-service.ts` publishes `flag.toggled`.

**Left out:**
- `auth-service.ts` lists `emit` in its header comment but never calls it. Its `member.joined` event goes out through `organization-service.ts` instead.
- `event-registry.ts`, `activity-service.ts`, `notification-service.ts`, `search-service.ts` and `webhook-service.ts` only subscribe.
- `src/types/event.ts` only declares the event names, and `mention-textarea.tsx` has an unrelated local function also called `emit`.
- `emitAndForget` in `event-bus.ts` calls `emit` internally, but nothing in the app uses it.
- Three test files also call `emit` (`tests/lib/event-bus.test.ts`, `tests/services/notification-service.test.ts`, `tests/services/activity-service.test.ts`). I counted them as tests rather than source files.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts, src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts
